Hundreds of thousands of years ago before the dawn of humanity and many of the other races upon the planet of Gaia. Before all of them there were the elves and the dragons. These 2 Races lived together in relative harmony for thousands of years. their empire spanned the globe and were highlighted by massive cities and temples, they lived in the height of technology and magic that worked together in harmony. However this peace could not, for one reason or another the Elves and dragons went to war with each other and this war spanning hundreds of years would result in the devastation of both empires. The climax of the war when Elven archmages detonated 1 large volcano system in the homeland of the dragons in an attempt to stop them. This did stop the dragons however it also destroyed half the world and covered the skies in ash, over the next hundred years both empires would collapse and the degradation of magic and technology followed soon after.  The planet repaired itself over thousands of years and eventually survivors of both empires would eventually emerge from hiding however the planet was much changed from when their ancestors lived on it. the 2 empires ever managed to regain the magical and technological supremacy they once had however their species did manage to endure. Records of these 2 empires and their advancements are few and far between however across Gaia there are many ruins left that may hold scraps of the technology and magic they once processed or it may contain records of the civilizations if you are willing to dig deep enough.
